project_context.name: SmartProv Landing Page
project_context.target_audience: Brazilian residential users, 35+ years, classes B/C/D
project_context.objective: High-conversion, award-winning marketing page to capture leads and WhatsApp contacts

visual_principles: Clarity-first minimalist layout focused on conversion.
Trust-first design: transparent pricing, local availability proof, genuine testimonials.
Mobile-native interactions: sticky CTAs, easy-to-tap plan cards.
Fiber-optic visual motifs: subtle gradients, glowing accents, clean geometric shapes.
Use 'Generous Spacing Philosophy': p-6 to p-12 for containers, letting content breathe.

layout_structure.layout: Sticky top, z-50, crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border/40). Flex container.
layout_structure.content: Logo 'SmartProv', Navigation (Planos, Combos, Benefícios), Primary CTA 'Assine Já', WhatsApp icon link.

layout_structure.layout: Grid cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[80vh] pt-24 pb-12 px-6 lg:px-12 relative overflow-hidden
layout_structure.content: Left: Strong claim 'Sua casa na velocidade da luz.' Subtitle emphasizing fiber for family/streaming. CEP Checker Input + Button (Check Viabilidade). Right: Image of Brazilian family bonding, layered with subtle fiber optic glowing graphic/gradient floating behind.
layout_structure.microinteractions: Fade-in up for text, slide-in for image. CEP button shows loading spinner on click.

layout_structure.layout: Bento Grid strategy or flex wrap. Container py-24 bg-surface. Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 px-6 lg:px-12
layout_structure.content: Section Title: 'Escolha a velocidade ideal'. 4 Plan Cards (500, 1000, 2000, 5000 mega). Card 1000 or 2000 Mega must have 'MAIS VENDIDO' badge and primary color border/shadow. Cards fetch from /api/site/plans (mocked nicely if API missing). Price prominent, features in list. CTA 'Assinar Plano'.
layout_structure.microinteractions: Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-2) and shadow-xl for cards. 'Mais Vendido' card pulses subtly.

layout_structure.section: Visual Calculator (What fits in X Mega)

layout_structure.content: Title 'Ainda melhor com seus streamings favoritos'. Endless marquee or Swiper carousel showing logos (Disney+, HBO Max, Globoplay, Deezer, Sky+). Include mention of Landline & Mobile combos.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, plan cards, accordion triggers) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case representing their role. Examples: data-testid='check-cep-input', data-testid='plan-card-1000', data-testid='whatsapp-floating-btn', data-testid='lead-form-submit'.

instructions_to_main_agent: The route for the landing page is /provedor, but you can build this as the main view in the app (e.g., App.js) assuming the routing will handle it, or explicitly use React Router.

API Integrations: Plans should ideally be fetched from /api/site/plans (mock this endpoint with a hardcoded fetch fallback if it fails, ensuring 500, 1000, 2000, 5000 mega plans exist). Leads form must POST to /api/site/leads.
WhatsApp buttons MUST open 'https://wa.me/{phone}?text={encoded_message}' where {phone} is a placeholder or env variable (e.g., 5511999999999).
Streaming logos (Disney+, HBO Max, etc.) should be implemented using simple text or SVG icons if real logos are unavailable, but position them in a continuous marquee.
Ensure high contrast ratios (APCA/WCAG). Use text-slate-900 for dark text and text-white on primary colored backgrounds.
Do NOT use pure Inter or Roboto for headings. Use the designated Google Fonts.
For the plans comparison, ensure the 'MAIS VENDIDO' card is visually popped out (e.g. scale-105 on md+ screens, glowing border).
